events.title: Sanofi To Buy Insmed For $41 Bln In Cash; Shares Gain
events.description: With a view to strengthening its presence in respiratory and rare diseases, French drug major Sanofi announced Tuesday an agreement to acquire biotechnology firm Insmed Inc. for $175 per share in cash, reflecting a total equity value of around $41.0 billion or €37.6 billion. According to the French drug major, Insmed is a transformative acquisition that will provide it with access to...

events.title: Oil Prices Hover Near Three-month Low On US-Iran Deal Hopes
events.description: Oil prices traded lower on Tuesday, hitting a three-month low due to increased Middle Eastern supplies and signs of renewed diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Iran conflict.

events.title: European Shares Mixed After Tech Rally
events.description: European stocks were mixed on Tuesday after rallying in the previous session amid revived enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: Asian Shares Rally As Huang's Return Revives AI Trade
events.description: Asian stocks advanced on Tuesday, with technology shares rallying as Jensen Huang's return to the helm of Nvidia helped to remove a key level of uncertainty from the AI trade.

events.title: Europe Car Registrations Maintain Momentum: ACEA
events.description: Europe's car market maintained its positive momentum during January to October period, the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association, or ACEA, said Tuesday. Car registrations increased 5.4 percent in the first ten months of the year.

events.title: European Shares Poised For A Breather After Sharp Rally
events.description: European stocks are seen opening mixed on Tuesday after posting their strongest gains in more than six months the previous day, led by technology and semiconductor stocks.

events.title: Japan Private Sector Growth Softest In 6 Months
events.description: Japan's private sector grew at the slowest pace in six months in November amid softer sales growth and intense cost pressures, flash survey data from S&P Global showed Tuesday. The flash composite output index dropped to 51.5 in November from 52.1 in the previous month.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Strong Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early strong gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, snapping an eight-session losing streak, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving above the 8,700 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets A Sea Of Green
events.description: Asian stock markets are a sea of green on Tuesday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, boosted by markets in South Korea, Japan and Taiwan amid a relief rally in semiconductor supplier stocks following the reinstatement of AI chipmaker Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang. Easing crude oil prices also aided market sentiment. Asian markets closed mostly lower on Monday.

events.title: Indian Markets Closed For Guru Nanak Jayanti
events.description: Indian stock markets remain closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti. Benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty plunged around 1.8 percent each on Monday as a global stock market rout prompted traders to lock in gains after four straight weeks of gains.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Tuesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished higher in two of three trading days since the end of the three-day slide in which it had given up almost 35 points or 2.2 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,450-point plateau and it's expected to open to the upside again on Tuesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher; Spikes 4.4%
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply higher in post-holiday session on Tuesday, reversing the sharp losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 jumping 4.4 percent to above the 59,900 level, with gains in across most sectors led by technology and financial stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Monday wrote a finish to the five-day losing streak in which it had retreated more than 175 points or 3.1 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,215-point plateau and it's expected to open in the green again on Tuesday.
